description: The page URL rejects HEAD (405) but redirects on GET: critical never learns the final URL and resolves the relative stylesheet href against the wrong directory.

thin.note: The new layer takes the final URL from its single GET (no HEAD probe), so the relative href resolves against /blog/landing/ and the job succeeds; expected-thin.css is critical's output when HEAD answers like GET. critical keeps the pre-redirect URL when its HEAD probe fails, resolves the relative href against / and throws FileNotFoundError.
